Brazilian passport holders do not have visa-free access to Vietnam, so you'll need an e-Visa for a 3-week (21-day) trip.

Key details:
- Max stay on e-Visa: up to 90 days, so 21 days is comfortably covered.
- Cost: USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry).
- Apply at the official portal: https://evisa.gov.vn/ (processing typically 2-3 business days, expedited options available).
- Valid for entry by air, land, or sea at any of the approved e-Visa ports (no restriction to a single nominated port).
- Your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.

Data as of 2026-08-17 — verify current policy at evisa.gov.vn before you travel.
